result.claim: Four dosage-consistent binary haplotypes over V001-V042 were reconstructed by weighted 4-ploid Minimum-Error-Correction under exact genotype-dosage constraints (all 42 dosages satisfied; weighted MEC cost 604 of 3569 total call weight, reached in 582/6000 restarts). The four haplotype alt-strings are H1=010101011010000011000100101001011100010000, H2=101011101011011111111011100101000011101111, H3=000000001010000001000000100001000000000000, H4=101011001110111001100011110111101011101011. Read evidence robustly co-phases two haplotype identities (hapA alt-set {V005,V007,V010,V012,V013,V020,V021,V029,V040} and hapB alt-set {V002,V004,V006,V008,V022,V027,V032,V038}) plus a hapC-specific alt at V026. All 42 sites are physically linked into a single phase block (V001-V042; every junction spanned by 6-13 reads), but the alt placement at 19 het sites where no read ever reads the alt allele is dosage-forced and not read-supported (flagged uncertain).

phase_blocks.basis: Single physically-linked block spanning V001-V042. Every adjacent variant junction is spanned by 6-13 reads and two long reads (R007,R010) individually cover V001-V042, so there is no read-coverage gap on which to defensibly break the block. Heterozygous (alt-allele) linkage is present at 18 het sites spanning V002-V040.

read_supported_subphase.note: These alt co-occurrence sets are stable across all 582 co-optimal solutions (up to label permutation) and constitute the read-defensible relative phasing.

payload.method_summary: Weighted polyploid Minimum-Error-Correction (k=4) with hard per-site alternate-dosage constraints. Reads encoded as (variant,bit,weight). EM/coordinate descent alternates: (E) assign each read to the haplotype minimizing weighted allele mismatch; (M) at each variant, set exactly alternate_dosage[v] of the four haplotypes to alt, choosing those with the largest weighted (alt-ref) vote margin, which guarantees dosage feasibility by construction. 6000 random restarts; the global minimum cost 604 was hit by 582 restarts. Phaseability of each variant is then classified from raw read evidence (homozygous / read-phaseable / unsupported-het), and phase blocks are inferred from read physical linkage.

public_objective.model: weighted Minimum-Error-Correction (MEC) for polyploidy k=4 under fixed genotype-dosage constraints
public_objective.variables: H in {0,1}^{4 x 42} (four haplotypes), plus assignment of each of 18 reads to one of 4 haplotypes
public_objective.hard_constraints: for every variant v: sum_{k=1..4} H[k,v] = alternate_dosage[v] (all 42 satisfied exactly)
public_objective.objective: minimize sum over reads r of sum over covered variants v of weight[r,v] * 1[H[assign(r),v] != observed_bit[r,v]]
public_objective.interpretation: 604/3569 weighted call-units are corrected; residual dominated by the 5 dosage-4 homozygous-alt sites and the 23 sites where every read reads reference, which force unavoidable read-vs-genotype mismatches.

robustness_certificate.optimizer: EM/coordinate-descent (read-cluster reassignment <-> dosage-constrained allele voting), 6000 random restarts
robustness_certificate.global_optimum_evidence: minimum weighted-MEC cost 604.0 was reached by 582 of 6000 independent random restarts
robustness_certificate.counterexample_class: The 19 unsupported_het sites (dosage 1 or 2 but zero alt observed in any read) are fundamentally underdetermined: any permutation of which haplotypes carry their alt allele yields the SAME MEC cost, so their alt placement in the returned haplotypes is an arbitrary dosage-satisfying assignment, not a read-inferred one.
robustness_certificate.label_degeneracy: ~0.35 apparent per-variant instability on hapA sites reflects only the exchangeable 4-label symmetry among the all-reference background haplotypes; the underlying co-phasing partition is invariant, consistent with permutation-invariant scoring.

result.method: python /run/out/phase.py and /run/out/finalize.py: parse observations.json into a weighted allele matrix; run dosage-constrained weighted-MEC EM with 6000 restarts; verify sum_k H[k,v]==dosage[v] for all v; classify variant phaseability from bit-1 read presence; run 4-permutation-aligned stability over all co-optimal solutions; emit final_solution.json and this manifest.
result.justification: Genotype dosages are exact biological constraints, so any admissible haplotype set must satisfy sum_k H[k,v]=dosage[v]; the M-step enforces this by construction while greedily honoring read votes, and the E-step is the standard MEC read-to-haplotype assignment. Convergence of 582 independent restarts to the identical cost 604 argues this is the global weighted-MEC optimum. The relative phasing that a permutation-invariant scorer rewards is the alt co-occurrence partition, which is identical across every co-optimal solution: alts observed together on a read (e.g. R003 linking V005/V007/V010/V012/V013/V020/V021/V029/V040; R006/R015 linking V002/V004/V008/V022/V027/V032/V038; R009 adding V006/V008) must lie on one haplotype. The 19 het sites at which no read ever reads the alt allele carry zero linkage information: every dosage-preserving permutation of their alt allele across haplotypes is equally optimal, so they are reported as uncertain rather than asserted.
unknowns: Which haplotype carries the alt allele at the 19 unsupported_het sites (V001,V003,V014,V015,V016,V017,V019,V023,V024,V028,V031,V033,V034,V035,V036,V037,V039,V041,V042) is not determined by any read.
Absolute haplotype labels are unidentifiable: only a co-phasing partition is recoverable, and only ~2-3 distinct haplotype identities are read-distinguishable from the 18 reads.
Whether the region should be split into multiple phase blocks under a stricter (heterozygous-linkage) criterion; physical linkage is continuous but het linkage thins near the ends.
